thread:
Lina Park: Quick sync — I want to enable the `microcache_prefetch` feature flag for a controlled canary tonight (target window 21:30 PT). Goal is to validate batching/cache interactions with short-sequence workloads and ensure no perf regression. Proposed approach: 3% traffic, EU-only, 15m hold, smoke script run. Need ops + oncall + eng-platform signoff and rollback steps.

Alex Chen: +1 on the small percent. Suggest we use a pod-count gating rather than pure traffic % — e.g., enable on 2 pods in eu-west-1 service pool so we can kill pods if needed. Also: enable verbose cache metrics for the canary (hit/miss, kv-fetch latency).

Sanjay Patel: Agree. Metrics to watch: p50/p95 token latency, 5xx rate, cache_hit_ratio, KV fetch p95, request CPU and GPU util. If any of these go over thresholds we abort. Proposed thresholds: p95 latency +30% vs baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% OR cache_hit_ratio drop > 10%.

Maria Gomez: I can wire the dashboard and a pager rule for the first two thresholds. I will create a temporary dashboard tab and an alert channel `#canary-observability` with a 1-min evaluation. Also plan to run smoke test harness after rollout step 1.

Lina Park: Rollout steps I'm imagining: 1) Staging smoke (already green) 2) Enable flag for 2 EU pods, sleep 10m, run smoke suite 3) If green, expand to 3 pods / ~3% traffic, 15m hold and full smoke 4) If green, 10% global for 30m then ramp. Rollback: flip flag off + tk flush-caches on affected pods + revert any transient config. Any missing items?

Theo: Add a step to capture request traces for 1% of canary requests (sampling) so we can see KV cache behavior cross-service. Also make sure we pin model variant (no live model swap) during canary.

Alex Chen: Command snippets for ops (tested):
```
# enable flag on a specific deployment/pod label
r3d ff set microcache_prefetch --label canary=true --namespace prod-eu-west --value on
# roll back quickly
r3d ff set microcache_prefetch --label canary=true --namespace prod-eu-west --value off
# flush cache on pod
kubectl exec -n prod-eu-west pods/<pod> -- /app/bin/cachectl flush
```

Sanjay Patel: Note: flush is eventual; recommend also incrementing a `cache_version` config so old entries invalidate immediately. I can add a small migration job to bump the version as part of rollback.

Maria Gomez: I'll create the dashboard and alerting now and post links. Will also add a short smoke checklist: basic gen path, 10 short queries, 5 medium queries, check no 5xx, p95 < x.

oncall-rr: I'm on call tonight. I can watch the `#canary-observability` channel during the rollout window. If you need me to trigger rollback I can do it immediately. Please add me to the runbook steps.

Lina Park: Thanks — please add runbook snippet to the playbook: include exact r3d commands and `kubectl` flush. Also include the oncall contact and expected SLO gates. I'll schedule the window for 21:30 PT and post a reminder 30m before. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: microcache_prefetch canary enable at 2026-03-17T21:30:00-07:00 (CID: dpl-6621). Triggered by Lina Park.

Alex Chen: One last ask — instrument a short synthetic that compares output quality (tiny eval) between canary and baseline so we catch any subtle regressions. I can add that to the smoke harness.

Lina Park: Perfect. I'll collect approvals here. If no objections by 20:45 PT we proceed.
